exit_codes.1: No scan result: invalid option, value, path or configuration, or a setup or output error
exit_codes.2: Scan completed but reached `--fail-on`; `diff` returns 2 with `--fail-on-new` or `--fail-on-drift`
exit_codes.3: Scan incomplete (API error, timeout, denied access, limit, malformed export); `diff` returns 3 when reports are not comparable
